component.name: OpenChime
component.summary: Chat client for an OpenChime server

description.p: OpenChime is a business chat system you can run yourself. This is its desktop client: messaging, channels, threads and search; calls with screen sharing and cameras, encrypted end to end; recorded video messages; and read-aloud, voice input and conversation summaries, all computed on the workspace's own server.
It signs in to a workspace on an OpenChime server and keeps its session in the desktop's keyring. A link to a workspace opens in it.
